params.body:
## Why

On 2026-09-18 12:37 a local run of `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter 'OwnStock|Vehicle|Export|Bidding|Order|Takeover|Rules|Smoke'` left this in the log: `WhatsApp send failed {"to":"32400000000","status":400,"body":"{\"error\":{\"message\":\"(#131030) Recipient phone number not in allowed list\"...`. Read as a request that had reached Meta with a valid token.

## What it was

Nothing left the machine. The line is the faked Meta answer of `IntegrationSmokeTest::test_whatsapp_fails_when_meta_refuses` (`Smoke` matches the filter): the test lists `whatsapp` in `OUTBOUND_IMPACT`, fakes `graph.facebook.com/*` with exactly that 400 body, and runs `stocklist:smoke --whatsapp-to=+32400000000`. `WhatsAppService::send` logs every non-2xx answer, faked or not. The log channel was `testing`, the number is the test number, and the empty `WHATSAPP_TOKEN` of phpunit.xml would have earned 401 (#190) from Meta, never 131030.

Checked with a tripwire right before the `Http::post` over the same filter (740 tests): the service reaches a request three times, all in `IntegrationSmokeTest`, all faked, token `test-token`, env `testing`, seal patterns empty. The service goes through Laravel's Http client and asks `Outbound::impact('whatsapp')` first. The two raw cURL calls (Nederland Mobiel, VIN lookup) sit behind `Outbound::impact`/`allows`; `ErrorApi` behind `Outbound::allowed()`. No hole.

## What changes

- `WhatsAppServiceTest::test_in_testing_a_send_without_a_fake_is_stopped_before_it_leaves`: whatsapp in `OUTBOUND_IMPACT`, no fake, the send throws `StrayRequestException` naming graph.facebook.com before a socket opens.
- `IntegrationSmokeTest::test_whatsapp_runs_only_with_an_explicit_number_and_respects_the_seal` ends with `Http::assertNothingSent()`.
- The 400 test documents that its log line belongs to a test run.
- Finding `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-18-whatsapp-bereikt-meta-vanuit-tests.md` (opgelost) records what was checked.

No application code changed. `@rule P3-7.2`, `P3-7.7`, `P1-5.12`.
params.title: Pin that a test run never reaches Meta: the 400 in the log was the fake
